newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Telefonica sets cash dividend from profits.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Telefonica sets cash dividend from profits.

text.p: Telefonica del Peru SA has agreed a cash dividend of 0.06 sol per share with a November 15 record date and a December 2 payout date, according to a Lima Stock Exchange report published Friday.
The dividend is based on profits made so far during 1996, the report said, adding that further dividends could be set from the same profits.
In July, Telefonica made its debut on the New York Stock Exchange, trading as American Depositary Shares.

Majority-owned by Spain's Telefonica de Espana after its $2.0 billion privatization in 1994, Telefonica has only one competitor, Tele 2000, and is operating in a country with the lowest phone density in Latin America and strong growing demand.
